readme_excerpt:
# greycard

A professional raw photo editor with accurate color, for Linux, macOS
and Windows. Fast, and open source.

[![greycard editing a mountain landscape: presets and history on the left, the picture in the middle, the histogram and Develop sliders on the right, the filmstrip along the bottom.](docs/images/develop.webp)](https://greycard.org)

I took my favorite parts of every editor I know and built the one I
wanted to use. I'm a software engineer and a
[photographer](https://jessolmstead.com), and greycard is already the
editor I use for my own work. It's still early, and there's a lot more
on the [roadmap](docs/roadmap.md). I'm not going to stop until it's a
complete, battle-tested editor.

**[Download](https://github.com/jessolmstead/greycard/releases/latest)** ·
[User guide](docs/user-guide.md) ·
[greycard.org](https://greycard.org)

## Highlights

- **Camera color match.** Give it a varied set of frames from your
  camera and it learns the camera's own JPEG look, such as Canon
  Standard or Fujifilm Provia, as a look you can pick.
  [How well it fits](docs/camera-match.md).
- **Masks that do more.** Absolute white balance on a mask makes mixed
  light easy, and the color mixer works inside a mask.
- **Scopes for the mask:** parade, waveform and vectorscope, which you
  can limit to the masked area to get skin tones right.
- **AI denoising on the raw sensor data.** I trained the model myself,
  and it works a treat on Canon, Fujifilm GFX, Nikon, Sony and
  Panasonic.
- **Your folders are the truth.** Edits live in a sidecar beside each
  raw. The library index makes finding and filtering fast without
  owning your photos.
- **Works across machines.** Cull a shoot on a NAS from local
  previews, and keep an archive drive in step with your edits.
- **Local AI masks** for subjects, objects, skies and people, down to
  eyes, lips, hair and clothing. All on your machine.
- **Quick culling** from the camera's embedded previews, so getting
  through a shoot is smooth.
- **Fast and familiar.** Native Rust, Slint and the GPU, so sliders
  update as you drag. The layout will feel at home if you're coming
  from Lightroom Classic. Lightroom presets load, and a Lightroom
  catalog comes across with its ratings, edits and collections.
- **The best open source algorithms.** greycard is GPL, so parts of the
  pipeline come straight from darktable and RawTherapee, credited in
  each file.

## Cameras

It opens what [rawler](https://github.com/dnglab/dnglab) decodes
([camera list](https://github.com/dnglab/dnglab/blob/main/SUPPORTED_CAMERAS.md)),
and I test on Canon, Fujifilm GFX and X-Trans, Nikon, Sony and
Panasonic raws.

## Not there yet

- The learned denoiser doesn't run on Fujifilm X-Trans raws yet.
- Nikon High Efficiency raws only open in a build from source with the
  `nikon-he` feature. The format is licensed, and shipping its decoder
  means royalties. I'm working on it.
- The Windows build isn't signed yet, so you have to click past a
  warning the first time.
- No build yet for Intel Macs.
- There is a Windows on ARM build, though a release can still go out
  without it while it's new. Its AI features run on the CPU alone,
  through a runtime it offers to download the first time you use one,
  and I haven't run it on an ARM laptop myself yet.

## Install

Download your system's file from the
[releases page](https://github.com/jessolmstead/greycard/releases/latest)
and unpack it.

- **Linux:** `sh install.sh`, or take the `.AppImage` instead, make it
  executable and run it (it needs FUSE, or `--appimage-extract-and-run`).
- **macOS:** open the `.dmg` and drag greycard to Applications (Apple
  silicon, macOS 13.4 or newer); the `.tar.gz`'s `sh install.sh` also
  adds the `greycard` command. [Step by step](docs/testing-on-a-mac.md).
- **Windows:** double-click `install.cmd`, or just run
  `bin\greycard-ui.exe` from the unpacked folder. `register.cmd` adds
  greycard to Open with for raws. The `aarch64-windows` zip is for
  Windows on ARM.

You'll want a GPU with Vulkan, or Metal on a Mac. Without one it
still opens, drawing in software and developing on the CPU, but
slowly.
[Building from source](docs/building.md) is a `cargo build --release`
once the libraries are in, and one script for the AI runtime.

## Feedback

Bugs, feature requests, things you love or hate: please tell me. Use
**Report a problem...** at the bottom of the left panel, or
[open an issue](https://github.com/jessolmstead/greycard/issues/new/choose).
A raw that renders wrong, with the camera model, is the most useful
thing you can send.

## More

- [User guide](docs/user-guide.md)
- [Where greycard fits](docs/where-greycard-fits.md) next to Lightroom,
  Capture One, darktable, RawTherapee and others
- [Changelog](docs/changelog.md)
- [Design notes](docs/notes.md)

GPL-3.0-or-later.

readme_excerpt: # Mouzi 🧹🐁 > **Your downloads, tamed.** Mouzi is a silent, elegant file organizer that lives in your system tray and keeps your Downloads folder (and any other folder) automatically tidy. It runs quietly in the background, monitors selected folders, and moves, renames, or sorts files based on customizable rules. [![Product Hunt](https://img.shields.io/badge/Product%20Hunt-🚀%20Launch-orange?logo=producthunt&color=ff6154)](https://www.producthunt.com/products/mouzi?launch=mouzi) [![Reddit](https://img.shields.io/badge/Reddit-r%2FMouzi-FF4500?logo=reddit)](https://www.reddit.com/r/Mouzi/) [![X](https://img.shields.io/badge/X-@hsrvibe-black?logo=x&logoColor=white)](https://x.com/hsrvibe) [![Windows](https://img.shields.io/badge/Windows-10%2F11-blue?logo=windows)](https://mouzi.cc) [![Linux](https://img.shields.io/badge/Linux-AppImage%2Fdeb%2Frpm-yellow?logo=linux)](https://mouzi.cc) [![Tauri](https://img.shields.io/badge/Built%20with-Tauri-FFC131?logo=tauri)](https://tauri.app) [![Rust](https://img.shields.io/badge/Backend-Rust-000000?logo=rust)](https://www.rust-lang.org) [![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/Frontend-React-61DAFB?logo=react)](https://react.dev) [![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-green.svg)](LICENSE) [![GitGem](https://gitgem.org/api/badge/github/hsr88/mouzi.svg)](https://gitgem.org/github/hsr88/mouzi) [![Download Mouzi](https://a.fsdn.com/con/app/sf-download-button)](https://sourceforge.net/projects/mozui/files/latest/download) --- ## 📸 Screenshots --- ## ✨ Features ### 🔇 Silent by Default - Runs 24/7 in the background with minimal resource usage (~5 MB RAM) - Automatically organizes new files as they arrive - Shows a subtle Windows toast notification with the count of organized files - Silent autostart with Windows ### 📁 Smart Rules Engine - **Images** (`.jpg`, `.png`, `.gif`, `.webp`...) → `Downloads/Images/` - **Documents** (`.pdf`, `.docx`, `.xlsx`...) → `Downloads/Documents/` - **Archives** (`.zip`, `.rar`, `.7z`...) → `Downloads/Archives/` - **Installers** (`.exe`, `.msi`...) → `Downloads/Installers/` - **Music** / **Video** → dedicated folders - **Catch-all** rule for everything else ### 🛠️ Fully Customizable - Create your own rules with extensions, regex patterns, and destination folders - Use dynamic placeholders in paths: `{year}`, `{month}`, `{day}`, `{extension}`, `{filename}` - Reorder rules by priority - first match wins ### 🚫 Ignore Rules (.mouziignore) - Per-folder ignore patterns — like `.gitignore` for your files - Set up via Settings UI or write a `.mouziignore` file manually - Supports wildcards (`*.tmp`), exact names (`.DS_Store`), and folders (`node_modules/`) ### 📂 Folder Modes Each watched folder can run in one of three modes: - **Silent** - automatically organize files as they arrive (default) - **Manual** - collect files and only process them when you click **Organize Now** - **Paused** - watch the folder but don't move anything ### 📦 Google Takeout Import - Import `.zip`, `.tgz`, or `.tar.gz` archives directly from Google Takeout - Files are extracted to a staging folder and sorted using your existing rules - No need to manually unzip and reorganize everything ### 📜 History & Undo - Every action is logged locally in SQLite - Undo any single move with one click - Clear history anytime ### 🌍 Multi-language Auto-detects your system language. Supported: - 🇬🇧 English - 🇵🇱 Polish - 🇮🇹 Italian - 🇩🇪 German - 🇫🇷 French - 🇷🇺 Russian - 🇯🇵 Japanese - 🇻🇳 Vietnamese - 🇪🇸 Spanish - 🇺🇦 Ukrainian *(Falls back to English if system language is not supported)* ### 🕶️ Dark Mode - Follows system theme, or force Light / Dark mode from settings ### 🔒 Privacy First - **100% offline** - zero cloud, zero file name uploads - **No telemetry** by default - **System files ignored** - `desktop.ini`, `Thumbs.db`, `.DS_Store`, and other OS hidden files are never touched - **Portable version available** - run without installing, leaves no trace in the registry - All data stored locally in your user profile folder --- ## 🌍 Help translate Mouzi Want to use Mouzi in another language or improve an existing translation? Community translations are welcome, and you do not need to work on the rest of the application. - Read the [step-by-step translation guide](CONTRIBUTING.md#translations). - Browse the current [locale files](src/i18n/locales). - Translation updates can be submitted directly as a pull request. If you want to add a new language, open an issue first so we can confirm the language code and avoid duplicate work. --- ## 📥 Download ### Windows | Installer | Size | Best For | |-----------|------|----------| | [`Mouzi_0.2.0_x64-setup.exe`](https://mouzi.cc/download) | ~4.8 MB | Regular users (auto-installer) | | [`Mouzi_0.2.0_x64_en-US.msi`](https://mouzi.cc/download) | ~6.8 MB | Enterprise / Active Directory | | [`Mouzi_0.2.0_x64-portable.exe`](https://mouzi.cc/download) | ~18.5 MB | Power users (no install) | > ⚠️ **Windows 10/11.** Requires the [Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime](https://developer.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-edge/webview2/) (pre-installed on most systems). ### Linux | Package | Size | Best For | |---------|------|----------| | [`Mouzi_0.2.0_amd64.AppImage`](https://mouzi.cc/download/linux) | ~86
